title: Scheduler — unattended loop: ready issue → PR → machine funnel → human merge · MVP as built, 2026-07

messages.label: tick: STOP check + reconcile
messages.note: ledger 'running' burst with no container → killed, task rolled back, attempts+1

messages.label: WORK burst: branch → code → test → PR
messages.note: serial — one burst globally; resumes if the task already has a session

messages.label: ASSESS burst: reviewer role, fresh session, clone ro at PR head, no GitHub credential
Post review as reviewer App: findings → REQUEST_CHANGES · clean → APPROVE
DEV round: resume session, fix findings, reply in threads
Push fixes → assess re-queued
messages.note: cycle repeats until APPROVE; machine rounds soft-cap at 3 (cursor advances, comment) — no human in this loop

messages.label: TEST burst after a clean assess: tester role, sandbox creds (TEST_* ∩ TESTING.md)
Post 🧪 test report (reviewer App); relay pre-existing defects as auto issues
Review + merge (gate 2)
messages.note: owner rounds hard-block at 3; re-ready resets the rails
